moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-spatial-volumetric-menu, written here): Three panels 150x92 (ONE accent on top, TWO, THREE) tilted rotateX −57° and rotateY −29° (perspective 520), stacked. Separation along screen Y: −56 / 0 / +56 px (plus a 4 px base step) on springs k200 c20, the middle at 0.45 s, the outer ones 60 ms later (bottom +40 ms more). Dashed lines join the corners once apart; y readouts at the side. Collapse 2.9-3.35 s power2.inOut. Params: tilt (rotX 57°, rotY 29°) · spread (56 px) · spring (k200 c20) · each (0.06 s) · collapse (0.45 s).
